photos.name: crumb-shot-torn-bun
photos.summary: Torn bun showing interior crumb — somewhat dense but golden orange from gochujang. Visible garlic pieces in the crumb. Held over a white plate.

photos.name: glazed-buns-in-dish
photos.summary: All 10 buns in a glass baking dish, deep golden brown with honey-soy glaze and white sesame seeds. Buns touching but varied in size — some larger than others.
